title: P-102 Vibration & Bearing Degradation Progression
question: How did the mechanical condition of pump P-102 degrade between 2024 and 2026, and what maintenance work orders were executed in response?
expected_reasoning_chain: In 2024, inspection IR-2024-0102 measured 4.1 mm/s vibration and 12.8 mm casing wall (WO-4102 bearing replacement). In 2025, IR-2025-0102 showed vibration rising to 5.3 mm/s and wall loss to 8.2 mm following seal leak incident INC-2025-017 (WO-5012 seal overhaul and 40 bar cap). In July 2026, IR-2026-0102 showed vibration spiking to 7.2 mm/s, discharge pressure hitting 42 bar, and casing thinning to 3.8 mm (near 3.5 mm retirement limit), prompting major overhaul under WO-6021.

title: Incident INC-2026-004 Root Cause and Sensor Disagreement
question: What caused incident INC-2026-004 on January 18, 2026, and how was the discrepancy between PT-102 and the local gauge resolved?
expected_reasoning_chain: PT-102 read 42.8 bar while local gauge PG-102 read 35.0 bar. Excessive pipe vibration transmitted through the mounting stand caused diaphragm silicone oil loss, creating a calibration offset. Technician replaced the Hastelloy sensor capsule under WO-6021 and added a vibration dampening capillary bracket.

title: Exchanger E-301 Fouling and Cleaning Cycle
question: What process indicators flagged fouling in heat exchanger E-301, and how was thermal efficiency verified after cleaning?
expected_reasoning_chain: Thermocouple TT-301 showed crude outlet temperature dropping 12 °C while shell pressure drop rose to 1.6 bar. Chemical cleaning and hydrojetting executed under WO-5240 / WO-6190 restored heat transfer coefficient U-value to 495 W/m²K (95% design duty).
